name: Sei Shōnagon
shortBio: Heian Japanese court philosopher and essayist who pioneered the zuihitsu ("following the brush") genre in The Pillow Book, developing an aesthetics of ephemeral particulars, wit (okashi), and phenomenological taxonomy.
centralQuestion: How can fragmentary attentiveness to fleeting sensory details and witty aesthetic judgment (okashi) illuminate lived experience without totalizing systems?

keyWorks.title: The Pillow Book (Makura no Sōshi)
keyWorks.description: Foundational zuihitsu philosophical collection cataloging perceptual nuances, aesthetic sensibilities, and courtly social observation.
